test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 11 Jul, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’.

I cannot use my office at the moment because __it being painted__.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect use of the verb form "**being painted**" without an auxiliary verb.
 
• The correct form should include the auxiliary verb "**is**" to form the present continuous tense.
 
• The correct phrase should be "**it is being painted**" to ensure grammatical correctness and clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"I cannot use my office at the moment because it is **being painted.**"*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "it had been paint"** – Incorrect tense and form of the verb.
 
• **Option 2: "it has being painted"** – Incorrect auxiliary verb usage.
 
• **Option 4: No substitution required** – This option is incorrect because the original segment is not grammatically correct.
